traits.quality: Visual fidelity, motion coherence and prompt adherence of the generated clip.
traits.speed: Wall-clock from submission to a downloaded clip (provider queue + render).
traits.cost: Marginal money cost per clip: self-hosted is cheap, free-tier quota next, billed APIs lowest. Derived from the backend's declared cost_tier.
traits.privacy: How far the prompt and reference frames travel: local_only > zero_retention (remote, not retained) > training_eligible (remote, may be used for training). Derived from the backend's declared data_policy / execution_locality.

quality.description: Visual fidelity matters most (hero shots, deliverables); billed cloud providers are acceptable.

speed.description: Drafts and previews where time to a downloaded clip matters most.

cost.description: Keep marginal spend low: self-hosted first, then free-tier quota, then billed APIs.

privacy.description: Prefer keeping prompt and frames on the machine (ComfyUI workflow), then zero-retention APIs; training-eligible providers last.
